description: Stable error registry for the Vanth remote protocol. code -> {status, message}.

PROTOCOL_MALFORMED.message: frame is not valid JSON or violates the protocol shape

PROTOCOL_OVERSIZED.message: frame exceeds the maximum allowed size

PROTOCOL_REPLAY_MISMATCH.message: idempotency key was reused with a different request

STATE_EPOCH_MISMATCH.message: request was bound to a stale remote state epoch

OPERATION_RETRY_PENDING.message: outcome not yet terminal; retry with the same idempotency key
